referral_record.referral_reason: Assessment of a thyroid nodule identified on examination.
symptoms: Painless neck lump noted for six weeks.
No difficulty swallowing or breathing reported.
prior_workup: TSH result reported within the laboratory reference interval.
Thyroid ultrasound reports a 1.4 cm right-lobe nodule and no suspicious cervical lymph nodes.

eligibility_criteria: Adult patients with a documented thyroid nodule requiring specialist assessment are eligible.
exclusion_criteria: Known thyroid malignancy already managed by an oncology service is not accepted through this nodule intake pathway.
triage_requirements: Routine referrals are appropriate when there is no airway compromise or rapidly enlarging neck mass.
Airway compromise or rapid enlargement requires an urgent pathway rather than routine scheduling.

validation_summary: The referral documents an adult patient with a thyroid nodule, the required thyroid workup, and no reported airway symptoms. It meets the stated eligibility and routine-triage criteria, so it is accepted for intake.
